label: The unde inference from dependence on being to the act of being: bridges, limitation and rivals
summary: Warrant-phase checkpoint 4. ST I q.4 a.1 (objection 3 and ad 3), q.3 a.4 (three proofs, ad 1, ad 2), De ente capp.3-4 (Baur/Koch) and q.7 a.1-2 were read in the materialized witnesses. The q.4 a.1 ad 3 inference was formalized: R-dep (7067553d) with the first unde (8d7e24dc, ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2), the second unde (89d82643, reception at the nature), the nature in act (073e1411) and 7de89edb gives R-act1 (ractOneFromDependence); with the witness (11437cb4) and inclusion (fdd2213a) it gives R-act2. The load map certifies that, given R-dep, each bridge is equivalent to what it delivers and the first is analytic on the dependence reading (ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1): the inference makes the commitment explicit. The limitation comparison certifies that finitude in perfection follows from the nature premise with or without reception, and that reception factors through the essence-only account. R-act1 with q.7 a.2 ad 1 (21b08802) gives a new support option for the esse-root leaf 29e71e43.
blocker: No argument on file for the composition step (an act other in content than the nature, had from another, is received in the nature as in a really distinct potency) that a rival granting dependence and caused existence must accept; R-act2 has textual warrant only. Next: formalize agreement-and-difference and test for a criterion of non-trivial shared perfection independent of the act reading; otherwise move horizontally to degrees of being or the OwnBeing E/L obligations.

current_assessment.scope: The q.4 a.1 ad 3 'unde' inference and its parallels (q.3 a.4 second proof, De ente capp.3-4, q.7 a.1-2) from R-dep to R-act1 and R-act2, over the shared GradesFrame with respect identity as content identity and own being as esse tantum; rivals: the quantifier view and Suárez's real-identity account; limitation at the scope of finitude in perfection and plurality of finite beings.
current_assessment.assessment: The unde inference is explicative, not probative: given R-dep, each bridge is equivalent to what it delivers (certified), and its stated grounds (R-dep; signification in q.3 a.4) are granted by every rival. Two separating steps: the act reading of 'actuality of forms' separates the quantifier view; the composition step (real reception: second unde = q.3 a.4 'oportet igitur' = De ente DE1 major with DE4 = q.7 a.2 'necesse est') separates Suárez too, and is one commitment. No argument on file for the composition step must be accepted by a rival granting R-dep and caused existence; its material instances carry over only through an analogy that De ente's 'aequivoce' leaves unargued. R-act1 in the real-reception sense: weak to moderate as an argued thesis; not defeated. At matching scope reception is not needed: finitude in perfection follows from the shared nature premise (certified), plurality from De ente's own modes of difference and matter; the essence-only accounts (quantifier view; Suárez) are favored there by parsimony. Overall standing unresolved; agreement-and-difference is the strongest open candidate for a shared explanandum. R-act2 gains nothing from the unde; De ente cap.4 supports only power-eminence at subsistent esse (9a0a4951), so locus (b)'s impersonal-source exclusion rests on R-act2 with textual warrant only. The esse-root-leaves grade of 29e71e43 ('P, moderate to strong') rests on q.7 a.2, whose 'necesse est' rests on the same composition step: recorded as a qualification, that assessment not edited. The quantifier view now has one item of positive warrant at matching scope on file (scope-limited parsimony); the semantic success of the quantificational analysis does not discriminate (q.3 a.4 ad 2). First grades.
current_assessment.next_test: Formalize agreement-and-difference (many beings agree in being, differ in nature) and test whether any criterion of non-trivial shared perfection is independent of the act reading; if none, move horizontally to degrees of being (5a948c37, e462cf2f) or the OwnBeing E/L obligations.
current_assessment.supersedes: none: the #2171 assessment (attempt 1b16fb17) and the esse-root-leaves assessment are kept; the latter's grade of 29e71e43 is qualified here, not revised.
